[P1] 世界经典童话故事绘本系列
穿靴子的猫
主编/李迎春 槐子/改编 王芷玄/绘

[P2] 从前，有一位磨坊主，他有三个儿子，还有一座磨坊、一头驴和一只猫。
在这位磨坊主去世后，他的大儿子继承了磨坊，他的二儿子牵走了驴。
他的小儿子只得到了那只猫。

[P3] 虽然个头儿不大，但这只猫相当机灵，而且是一位捕鼠能手。它捕杀老鼠无数，常年负责为磨坊消除鼠害。
小儿子也一直很喜欢这只猫。可是，现在他只有一只猫，连给自己和猫买食物的钱都没有。
他抱着猫在树丛下面坐下来，躲避着秋天冷飕飕的风。想到冬天即将到来，他和猫还没有地方住，就不禁叹气。

[P4] 听到小儿子叹气，猫开口说道：“给我一双靴子、一顶帽子和一个布口袋。”
“什么？”小儿子吃了一惊。
“把靴子、帽子和布口袋给我，我就能让咱们有饭吃、有地方住。”猫说。
小儿子没钱去买，就把自己的靴子、帽子和一个空空的破布口袋给了猫。

[P5] 当时，在小儿子和猫居住的国家，正有一个食人恶魔出没。
没人知道恶魔的巢穴在哪里。只知道每隔一段时间，恶魔就会出现，冲进城镇，伤害百姓。
这只恶魔不但强壮、凶暴，还会变形，狮子、飞鸟、老鼠、蟑螂它都能变。骑士和军队都对它束手无策。
国王只得贴出告示：无论是谁，只要能够杀死恶魔，就有重赏！

[P6] 当时，在小儿子和猫居住的国家，正有一个食人恶魔出没。
没人知道恶魔的巢穴在哪里。只知道每隔一段时间，恶魔就会出现，冲进城镇，伤害百姓。
这只恶魔不但强壮、凶暴，还会变形，狮子、飞鸟、老鼠、蟑螂它都能变。骑士和军队都对它束手无策。
国王只得贴出告示：无论是谁，只要能够杀死恶魔，就有重赏！

[P7] 猫穿上主人的靴子、戴上主人的帽子，背着空空的布口袋去王宫见国王。
“我能杀死恶魔！”猫对国王说。
“你？”国王不太相信，这只猫的个子实在太小了，看起来很不起眼。
“只要您给我足够装满这个布口袋的谷粒，我就能杀死恶魔。”猫说。
试试也没什么损失，国王这么想。
他命人取来谷粒，装满猫的布口袋。

[P8] 恶魔再次出现，他在城镇中咆哮着，横冲直撞，撞开街边居民紧锁的门，冲进去伤人。
穿着靴子的猫背着装满谷粒的口袋，抬起爪子，把帽檐压了压——猫上场的时候到了。

[P9] 跟巨大的恶魔比起来，小小的猫个头儿简直微不足道。和恶魔的力气比起来，猫的力气也微不足道。但是，穿靴子的猫非常灵活。它趁着恶魔不注意，把装满谷粒的布口袋系在恶魔的腰带上，用爪子在布口袋底部抓出一个很小的破口。然后，它又灵巧地跳下，躲了起来。

[P10] 等到恶魔吃饱了、闹够了，满足地哼哼着返回自己的住处。
穿靴子的猫从藏身的地方走出来，跟着从布口袋破洞漏出来的谷粒踪迹，找到了恶魔的住处。

[P11] 恶魔的住处是一座宫殿。这座宫殿既结实、宽敞又非常豪华、舒适。
穿靴子的猫走到宫殿门口，敲了敲门。
“伟大的恶魔殿下！”穿靴子的猫说，“我听到了种种关于您丰功伟绩的传说，所以冒昧地前来拜访。”
恶魔听到来客赞美他，得意忘形。它高高兴兴地把门打开了。

[P12] 穿靴子的猫走进恶魔的宫殿，取下帽子，弯腰向恶魔鞠了个躬。
“伟大的恶魔殿下，我听说过各种关于您的传说。”穿靴子的猫非常有礼貌地说，“有人说，您能变形，可以变成各种动物。这是真的吗？”
“当然！”恶魔得意地将头一甩，眨眼间就变成了一头狮子。
“啊啊啊啊啊！”穿靴子的猫装作非常震惊、害怕，吓得跳了起来，连帽子都掉了。
“哈哈哈哈哈！”恶魔得意地大笑起来。

[P13] “能啊！”恶魔把头一点，
眨眼间就变成了一条狗，冲着穿
靴子的猫狂吠起来。
“呀呀呀呀呀！”穿靴子的
猫又装作害怕，尖叫起来。
然后，恶魔又变回了原形。“你看到了，我能
变形。”“果然比传说中更神奇，更了不起！”穿
靴子的猫赞美道，然后口气一变，“但是，狮子是
很大的动物，跟您的体型近似，所以，变成狮子比
较容易吧。您能变成小一些的东西吗？”，

[P14] 恶魔又变回了原形，
满意地点了点头。
“但是，更小的东西跟您的体型相差太大，肯定是变不了的。”穿靴子的猫把前爪压在胸口说，“比如，您肯定没法变成老鼠吧。”
“别小看我！我什么都能变！”恶魔说着，把身体一缩，变成了一只小老鼠。

[P15] 穿靴子的猫扑上去，把小老鼠抓住吃掉了。
恶魔就这样被消灭了。

[P16] 恶魔的宫殿也空了。
这样一座又大、又舒适、又华丽的
房子，空着太浪费了。
穿靴子的猫带着他的主人和其他没有地方住的穷人住了进去。
他们再也不用担心没有地方住，也不用害怕冬天的寒风了。

[P17] 对了，穿靴子的猫还拿到了
国王给的赏金。
它给自己买了一双新靴子。
full_text_en:
[P1] World Classic Fairy Tale Picture Book Series
The Cat in Boots
Editor-in-Chief / Li Yingchun  Adapted by / Huai Zi  Illustrated by / Wang Zhiyuan

[P2] Once upon a time, there was a miller who had three sons, as well as a mill, a donkey, and a cat.
After the miller passed away, his eldest son inherited the mill, and his second son took the donkey.
His youngest son only received the cat.

[P3] Although small in size, this cat is quite clever and an excellent mouser. It has killed countless mice and has long been responsible for eliminating pests from the mill.

The youngest son has always loved this cat. But now, he only has the cat, and not even enough money to buy food for himself and the cat.

He sits down with the cat under the bushes, sheltering from the cold autumn wind. Thinking about the approaching winter, and that he and the cat still have no place to live, he can't help but sigh.

[P4] Hearing the youngest son sigh, the cat spoke up: "Give me a pair of boots, a hat, and a cloth bag."
"What?" the youngest son was surprised.
"Give me the boots, hat, and cloth bag, and I can get us food and a place to live," said the cat.
The youngest son had no money to buy them, so he gave the cat his own boots, hat, and an empty, torn cloth bag.

[P5] At that time, in the country where the youngest son and the cat lived, a man-eating demon was on the loose.
No one knew where the demon's lair was. All they knew was that every so often, the demon would appear, rush into towns, and harm the people.
This demon was not only strong and fierce, but could also transform—into a lion, a bird, a mouse, or even a cockroach. Knights and armies were powerless against it.
The king had to post a notice: whoever could kill the demon would receive a great reward!

[P6] At that time, in the country where the youngest son and the cat lived, a man-eating demon was on the loose.
No one knew where the demon's lair was. All they knew was that every so often, the demon would appear, rush into towns, and harm the people.
This demon was not only strong and fierce, but could also transform—into lions, birds, mice, and even cockroaches. Knights and armies were powerless against it.
The king had to post a notice: whoever could kill the demon would receive a great reward!

[P7] The cat put on the master's boots, wore the master's hat, and carried an empty cloth bag to the palace to see the king.
"I can kill the demon!" the cat said to the king.
"You?" The king didn't believe it. The cat was too small and looked insignificant.
"As long as you give me enough grain to fill this cloth bag, I can kill the demon," the cat said.
There's no real loss in trying, the king thought.
He ordered someone to bring grain and fill the cat's cloth bag.

[P8] The demon appears again, roaring through the town, charging wildly, smashing open the locked doors of street-side homes, and rushing in to harm people.
The cat in boots, carrying a sack full of grain, lifts his paw and presses his hat brim down—It’s time for the cat to take the stage.

[P9] Compared to the huge demon, the little cat was tiny. Compared to the demon's strength, the cat's strength was also negligible. But the cat in boots was very agile. It took advantage of the demon's inattention, tied the bag full of grain to the demon's belt, and used its claws to make a small hole at the bottom of the bag. Then, it nimbly jumped down and hid.

[P10] After the demon had eaten his fill and had his fun, he returned to his dwelling, humming contentedly.
The cat in boots came out from his hiding place, following the trail of grains leaking from the torn bag, and found the demon's dwelling.

[P11] The demon's residence was a palace. This palace was sturdy, spacious, and extremely luxurious and comfortable.
The cat in boots walked to the palace door and knocked.
"Great Demon Majesty!" said the cat in boots, "I've heard many legends about your great achievements, so I boldly come to pay my respects."
The demon, flattered by the visitor's praise, became overjoyed and proudly opened the door.

[P12] The cat in boots walked into the demon's palace, took off his hat, and bowed respectfully to the demon.
"Your Excellency, the great demon, I've heard many legends about you," the cat in boots said politely. "Some say you can transform and turn into all kinds of animals. Is that true?"
"Of course!" the demon boasted, tossing his head, and in an instant, he turned into a lion.
"Aaaaaah!" the cat in boots pretended to be extremely shocked and frightened, jumping up in terror, even dropping his hat.
"Hahahaha!" the demon laughed triumphantly.

[P13] "Yes, I can!" The demon nodded his head, 
and in an instant transformed into a dog, barking furiously at the cat in boots. 
"Yaaah yaaah yaaah!" The cat in boots pretended to be frightened and screamed. 
Then, the demon returned to his original form. "You see, I can transform." "Indeed, even more magical and amazing than the legends say!" praised the cat in boots, then his tone changed, "But, a lion is a large animal, similar in size to you, so transforming into a lion must be easier. Could you transform into something smaller?"

[P14] The demon returned to his original form,
and nodded in satisfaction.
"But, something smaller is too different in size from yours; you surely can't transform into it," said the cat in boots, pressing his front paws to his chest. "For example, you certainly can't turn into a mouse, right?"
"Don't underestimate me! I can turn into anything!" said the demon, shrinking his body and turning into a tiny mouse.

[P15] The cat in boots pounced and caught the little mouse, eating it.
The demon was thus destroyed.

[P16] The demon's palace was now empty.
Such a big, comfortable, and beautiful house was too wasteful to leave empty.
The cat in boots brought his master and other poor people who had nowhere to live and moved in.
They no longer had to worry about having no place to live, nor fear the cold winter winds.

[P17] By the way, the cat in boots also received
a reward from the king.
It bought itself a new pair of boots.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《穿靴子的猫》的封面，展示了书名、系列名称及主创人员信息，配有一只戴着帽子、穿着靴子、背着袋子的卡通猫形象。
[P2] 本页讲述了磨坊主去世后，三个儿子分别继承了磨坊、驴和猫，其中最小的儿子只得到了那只猫。
[P3] 小儿子与他继承的猫在树林中休息，他为没有食物和住所而忧愁，感叹冬天即将到来。
[P4] 猫向小儿子提出要一双靴子、一顶帽子和一个布口袋，承诺能换来食物和住所；小儿子虽惊讶但因无钱购买，便将自己的旧物给了猫。
[P5] 本页介绍了小儿子和猫所居住的国家正遭受一个强大且会变形的食人恶魔的威胁，国王为此悬赏捉拿，画面中恶魔正在追赶惊慌的百姓。
[P6] 本页介绍了小儿子和猫所居住的国家正遭受一个强大且会变形的食人恶魔的威胁，国王为此悬赏捉拿，画面中恶魔正在追赶惊慌的百姓。
[P7] 猫穿上靴子和帽子，带着空布袋去王宫见国王，声称能杀死恶魔，国王起初不信，但最终同意给予谷粒作为报酬，命人装满猫的布袋。
[P8] 恶魔再次袭击城镇，破坏房屋、惊吓居民；穿着靴子的猫背着装满谷粒的口袋，准备迎战恶魔。
[P9] 穿靴子的猫利用灵活身手，在恶魔不注意时将装满谷粒的布袋系在恶魔腰间，并在袋底抓出破口后迅速躲藏起来。
[P10] 恶魔吃饱后返回住处，穿靴子的猫跟随从布袋破洞漏出的谷粒踪迹，找到了恶魔的住处。
[P11] 穿靴子的猫来到恶魔的宫殿门口，通过赞美让恶魔得意忘形并打开了门。
[P12] 穿靴子的猫进入恶魔宫殿，通过恭维和假装害怕，成功激怒并取悦了恶魔，使其展示变形能力，为后续行动铺路。
[P13] 穿靴子的猫在恶魔宫殿中，先夸赞恶魔变形能力，随后引导其变成狗并假装害怕，接着又请求恶魔变成更小的东西，为后续计划做铺垫。
[P14] 穿靴子的猫继续激将恶魔，声称其无法变成更小的生物如老鼠，恶魔为证明自己能力，当场变身为一只小老鼠。
[P15] 穿靴子的猫扑向变成小老鼠的恶魔，将其吃掉，从而消灭了恶魔。
[P16] 恶魔的宫殿被空置，穿靴子的猫带领主人和其他无家可归的穷人搬了进去，从此不再担心居无定所和寒冬侵袭。
[P17] 穿靴子的猫因消灭恶魔而获得国王赏金，并用赏金为自己买了一双新靴子。
